license_source: Local LICENSE-3RD-PARTY.md explicitly labels driver BSD-3-Clause; LICENSE permits modification with notice/disclaimer retention and no endorsement
sqlite_engine: LICENSE-SQLITE states public domain; LICENSE-SQLITE_VEC MIT and LICENSE-3RD-PARTY notices retained unchanged
purity: Innocuous is a caller assertion, not runtime purity enforcement; no blanket enabling or automatic promotion from Deterministic. Only separately audited pure evaluator callbacks explicitly opt in.
registration: Existing default-driver RegisterFunction collection is retained; existing Open installs exact descriptors for new connections; no new global registry, custom bypass, unsafe conn/TLS access or trusted_schema change
compatibility_limits: Adding an exported struct field can break external unkeyed FunctionImpl literals; future full consumer compile needed
Existing binaries remain unchanged and do not learn new callbacks or flags
This patch enables driver expression of a SQLite flag only, not F08 correctness, SQL24 adoption, writer fencing or product acceptance
No changes to scalar/aggregate callback lifetimes, VolatileArgs, IDs, error handling, synchronization or connection-hook order
